about: The approved sound effects bank. The mix builder only accepts files listed here, matched by sha256.

entries.name: Tap
entries.description: One dry, bright tap with no pitch.
entries.bestJob: A tap on screen, a single item landing in place.

entries.name: Double click
entries.description: Two dry clicks close together, like a double click.
entries.bestJob: A double click on a file or icon.

entries.name: Dry tap
entries.description: One dry tap.
entries.bestJob: A light tap; a quiet alternative to #1.

entries.name: Crispy click
entries.description: A crisp press and release with a short pitched tick.
entries.bestJob: A switch flipping, a toggle, a crisp UI press. Second choice for a mouse click.

entries.name: Mouse click
entries.description: A dry press and release.
entries.bestJob: A cursor clicking a button, link or menu item.

entries.name: Pop
entries.description: A tiny round pop with a quick drop in pitch.
entries.bestJob: Something popping in with an overshoot: a badge, an icon, a puck.

entries.name: UI pop
entries.description: Two small round bloops that bend up in pitch.
entries.bestJob: A window, menu, panel or card opening. Its two bloops fit window-then-icon.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: A few tight clicks with a small pitched chirp.
entries.bestJob: A button press with a little confirmation; second choice for a window opening.

entries.name: Select
entries.description: A soft low tone with clicks on top and a quick rising blip at the end.
entries.bestJob: A highlight or selection: a marker sweeping a word, an item being picked.

entries.name: Soft swell swoosh
entries.description: Soft air that swells and stops. Low and wide, no pitch.
entries.bestJob: A pull-back or long camera move; a reveal as something shrinks into place.

entries.name: Short swoosh
entries.description: Short, soft and full air. No pitch.
entries.bestJob: A medium camera push or zoom; peak it on the zoom's fastest frame.

entries.name: Air puff
entries.description: A very short air puff, low and full.
entries.bestJob: A quick swipe, a fast glide, a short dash of the cursor.

entries.name: Deep whoosh
entries.description: A low, round air swell that rises and falls. Mostly low end, so it is weak on a phone speaker.
entries.bestJob: A big slow move on a speaker with real low end. Weak on phone speakers, so use sparingly.

entries.name: Typing key
entries.description: A single soft key press.
entries.bestJob: Typing, one hit per visible keystroke, quiet under the voice and at least 6 frames apart.

entries.name: Charge-up riser
entries.description: A noise wash with a thin whistle sliding slowly upward the whole way. Sci-fi feel.
entries.bestJob: The one riser: the build from the hook into the main point.

entries.name: Charge-up with taps
entries.description: A thin rising whistle over noise with ticks on it, then five separate clicks at the end. Sci-fi feel.
entries.bestJob: Riser alternative with a clicky landing. Only as the one riser.

entries.name: Noise riser
entries.description: A dense noise and low rumble build for about 2 seconds, then a low tail.
entries.bestJob: The default riser: the build from the hook into the main point.

entries.name: Reverse crash
entries.description: A cymbal crash played backwards, swelling and cutting off.
entries.bestJob: Riser alternative: a reverse crash swelling into the cut. Only as the one riser.

entries.name: Shutter
entries.description: A short dry noise burst, then a smaller second click.
entries.bestJob: A screenshot or capture being taken.

entries.name: Bright shutter
entries.description: A bright noise burst with a thin high whine on top.
entries.bestJob: A bright capture moment; a photo or frame snapping in.

entries.name: Camera shutter click
entries.description: A softer first click, then a bright second click.
entries.bestJob: A screenshot with a two-step click.

entries.name: DSLR click
entries.description: One quick double shutter click.
entries.bestJob: A quick capture; frames freezing into a still.

entries.name: Shutter burst
entries.description: Four shutter clicks with a ringing metallic tail.
entries.bestJob: A burst of captures, several stills in a row.

entries.name: Flicker fast
entries.description: Four very fast clicks, like a light flickering.
entries.bestJob: Something flickering on: a light, a screen waking up.

entries.name: Flicker whine
entries.description: Four fast clicks with a high whine running across them and a noise tail.
entries.bestJob: A screen powering on with a whine; a glitchy reveal.

entries.name: Flicker three
entries.description: Three fast dry clicks.
entries.bestJob: Three quick items appearing in a row.

entries.name: Flicker four
entries.description: Four very fast clicks.
entries.bestJob: Four quick items appearing in a row.

entries.name: Counter run
entries.description: A long fast ticking run (about 20 ticks) with a steady high tone over it, like a counter.
entries.bestJob: A counter or number climbing; a progress bar filling.

entries.name: Speed-up run
entries.description: A fast ticking run that speeds up and ends on a hit. Bright and busy.
entries.bestJob: Something speeding up and landing on a result.

entries.name: 8-bit chatter
entries.description: Buzzy game-style chatter, about 36 quick blips.
entries.bestJob: An agent or chat 'thinking'; rapid machine chatter. Use once at most.

entries.name: Digital text
entries.description: A stream of about 12 crackly noise ticks with a faint tone.
entries.bestJob: A stream of text or data scrolling in.

entries.name: Digital blips
entries.description: Three short bright blips, each with a small high pitched tick on top.
entries.bestJob: Three items lighting up in turn.

entries.name: Digital blip
entries.description: One short bright blip with a small high pitched tick on top. One hit cut from #83.
entries.bestJob: One item lighting up or being read; a status changing.

entries.name: Night vision sweep
entries.description: A quick click, then a pitched whine that drops and then holds high. Sci-fi.
entries.bestJob: A scan, a vision mode switching on; a sci-fi reveal. Use once at most.

entries.name: Chime
entries.description: Bright high ringing tones stacked together, with a soft low pulse under them.
entries.bestJob: A success moment. Use rarely; most chimes sound cheap.

entries.name: Soft cut tick
entries.description: A tiny tick with a faint pitch.
entries.bestJob: A caption or label appearing; a soft hard-cut tick.

entries.name: Tiny click A
entries.description: A tiny tick, 10 ms.
entries.bestJob: A tiny tick for a small label or line appearing.

entries.name: Tiny click B
entries.description: A tiny tick, 10 ms.
entries.bestJob: A line of text appearing in a terminal or chat.

entries.name: Bright tick
entries.description: A tiny bright tick.
entries.bestJob: A line of text appearing in a terminal or chat; a bright tiny tick.

entries.name: Switch press
entries.description: Press and release, two small clicks each with a short low knock.
entries.bestJob: Something switching off or powering down; a press with a knock.

entries.name: Switch toggle
entries.description: Press and release, two small clicks each with a short pitched blip.
entries.bestJob: A toggle flipping on.

entries.name: Scroll run
entries.description: 19 soft low clicks over a second.
entries.bestJob: Cards or items sliding out in a row; a list scrolling.

entries.name: Drop bloop
entries.description: A bright synth bloop that bends up fast.
entries.bestJob: Something dropping in and landing softly; a small arrival.

entries.name: Pulse rise
entries.description: A low synth tone pulsing six times as it slowly rises.
entries.bestJob: A slow rise or power-up on one element (and its reverse for the way back).

entries.name: Glitch crackle
entries.description: A tiny digital crackle with a faint pitch.
entries.bestJob: A single terminal line glitching in. Never on a list, where repeated crackles sound broken.
